title: Mixed Event — Rise as One! — Episode6 To Understand Max

meta.Event Outline: On one of his daily runs, Akito has an encounter with a dog and his owner. The pair has been training day by day in the hopes of one day winning a national disc dog competition. But the day before their next competition, this dog owner sprains his ankle...

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I should get to know Max better...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, such as what makes him happy or upset...
As well as how he moves and reacts to things...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If you learn those things and develop some trust, I have a feeling that you'll become much more comfortable around him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess I get what she's saying...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But is learning more about who he is really gonna help me feel less scared...?)

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, I have to give it a try...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The reason I said I'd take Ishihara's place in that competition at all is because I could tell Max cares about his partner.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (If I can learn more about Max's personality like Mochizuki said, then...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wonderful...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, how exactly am I supposed to get to know Max better...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, about that...
Why don't we start by watching how he behaves normally?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We can stand at a bit of a distance.
That should be less stressful for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That sounds good.
The simple act of observing with interest should give you more than enough information.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I know! What if we all...?!

rows.Speaker: Dogs
rows.Line:
Woof!
*Bark*
Woof.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, Shibao, don't tug on your leash!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're so excited about making new friends!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, including Robo-Dog.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Dog
rows.Line: *Howl*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Who would've guessed the day would come when I'd be dog-watching...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm not learning much just seeing him walk around like this... Is this enough?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How are you feeling, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Uhh... Okay.
We are standing pretty far away.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm not sure if I'm really learning anything about Max.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Really? I thought going for a walk together was a wonderful idea.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For example, Samo's walking in lockstep with Hanasato, which tells me that he likes receiving attention from her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Shibao has a strong sense of curiosity.
So strong that he can't seem to stay away from Robo-Dog.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Shall we put that to the test?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Robo-Dog, triple Axel!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Dog
rows.Line: *Howl*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
Did Robo-Dog just jump up and twirl around in the air?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh... Hehe.
Shibao can't seem to get enough of him.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! He's sniffing him so much!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: See?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Wait, why's it able to jump like that...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Still, it's pretty clear now that each dog has a different personality...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, what about Max...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He walks a lot slower than the other dogs...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He's even stopping to look at Ishihara from time to time for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is he worrying about his partner's ankle...?)

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Whoa! Look at all the doggies!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Stop! You shouldn't try to touch them without asking. I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Hehe. Do you like dogs?

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Yeah! It's really cool how smooth this one's fur is!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Oh, are you talking about Max?
Would you like to try petting him?

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Really?! Yay!
Hehe. I'm gonna pet his head!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Hm? His head...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd avoid his head or bottom since many dogs don't like being touched there immediately.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Uh-oh...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, don't go touching his...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He's fine with it? No, he looks a little uncomfortable... But he's not doing anything about it...)

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: *Lick*

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
H-Haha!
Mom, he licked me!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
That's wonderful.
Now, you should thank this young man for letting you pet his dog.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line:
Okay! Thanks for letting me pet your dog!
Bye bye, doggie!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Thank you for being so kind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He was so calm...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He didn't like being touched on the head, right?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
But Max wouldn't kick up a fuss over that.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: He also knew that it was a kid who was petting him... He's just a really nice guy!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I could tell...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He's been worried sick about his partner's ankle...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And he didn't bark at that kid or anything, even though he was uncomfortable.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He's really just that nice...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How do you feel now, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, uhh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I have a slightly better idea of what he's like. I'm definitely less scared of him now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?!
Yay! My idea worked!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it did! Then, why don't we keep watching Max for a little while longer?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, but... I don't know how much more I'll get out of just watching him go for a walk...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, right... Maybe we should have him do a few different things.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we try something a little more interesting next...?
